items.claim: CEO 表示若 CLARITY 法案未過，對 Coinbase 而言大致照常營運，受損的是美國消費者
items.quote: I think Coinbase would be fine.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 稱法案通過仍較佳，因其提供跨政府任期的持久性
items.quote: So we still think on margin, it's better if the CLARITY Act passes.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 稱與 Circle 的合約續約條件已達成，將以相同條款續約
items.quote: we have already met the conditions for the Circle contract to renew
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CEO 說明加入 Open USD 的理由是多穩定幣平台定位
items.quote: the short reason is that we're a multi-stablecoin platform.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 被問及多位高階主管離職，稱策略沒有改變
items.quote: There's nothing that's changing about the strategy.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 稱高階主管異動皆為個別決定
items.quote: these were all individual decisions.
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CEO 回應 AI agent 無品牌忠誠度的問題，稱信任在 agent 時代仍重要
items.quote: I think trust will continue to be important in that world.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 引述 Base 的費用與結算速度作為對 agent 的價格競爭力
items.quote: actually delivers like sub $0.01 and sub 1-second settlement.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 說明成長行銷回收期的基準與近期表現
items.quote: seeing a 1-year payback on growth marketing efforts, but recently, we've outperformed this benchmark.
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CFO 稱新產品（如預測市場）早期訊號顯示帶動額外現貨交易量而非互相蠶食
items.quote: These early days are actually indicating that we're seeing incremental trading coming
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CEO 說明以資產存放量階層誘因（Coinbase One Card 回饋率）鼓勵客戶存放更多資產
items.quote: you can get a higher rate on Coinbase One Card, the more that
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 稱本季付費 Coinbase One 訂閱戶創歷史新高，且發生在交易量下滑的市場
items.quote: we saw an all-time high in paid
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CEO 談比特幣相關交易占比下降，並稱比特幣會回來
items.quote: And I think Bitcoin will come back in a big way, too, by the way.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 表示 agentic finance 目前不提供具體數字或預測
items.quote: have any specific numbers or forecast to share on that at the moment.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 稱預先 IPO 永續合約開放美國客戶在路線圖上，將持續推動
items.quote: In terms of U.S. access, that is on the road map, and we'll keep pushing on that.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 預期 Robinhood、Stripe 等自建區塊鏈後，區塊鏈也會出現類似穩定幣的整併
items.quote: So my guess is we're going to see something similar happen with blockchains.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CEO 承諾持續投資 Base 並開放給所有人建置
items.quote: to continue to invest in Base. We're going to make sure everyone can build on top of it.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 對 Hyperliquid 合作表示願意分享 USDC 經濟利益以推動網路效應
items.quote: we're happy to share economics to drive this network effect.
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CEO 承諾持續投資 USDC 成長
items.quote: we're going to keep investing in USDC to keep growing it.
items.speaker: Brian Armstrong

items.claim: CFO 被問 Coinbase One 單位交易收益是否壓縮，稱整體淨單位經濟為正，但收入會在損益表間轉移
items.quote: So I think overall, this will be more net unit economic positive to us.
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

items.claim: CFO 稱若會員普及，收入將在損益表各項目間轉移
items.quote: But you will see the revenue shift through the P&L if we
items.speaker: Alesia Haas

qa_flags.question: Coinbase One 會員每交易一美元的營收是高於或低於非會員（增益或 take rate 壓縮）
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 自稱給「不令人滿意的答案」，未給出每單位營收數字，只稱平均單位經濟較高、邊緣有例外

qa_flags.question: 多位高階主管本季離職，策略為何
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 與 CFO 皆以人才深度與接班規劃回應，未說明離職原因，稱皆為個別決定

qa_flags.question: Hyperliquid 合作顯示第三方持有足夠 USDC 即可取得多數 USDC 經濟利益，如何保護長期經濟利益
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 與 CEO 談網路效應與願意分享經濟利益，未回應如何保護長期經濟利益或給出分潤比例

qa_flags.question: agentic commerce 的營收規模與規劃
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 稱仍很早期，不提供具體數字或預測
